summary: Frontend-only sidebar navigation restructure verified end-to-end. Mock login (empty fields) succeeds, Dashboard is default landing page (data-testid='dashboard-page' present). Sidebar shows three groups (ANALYTICS, MARKETPLACE, TOOLS) with all expected items in correct order, plus footer with Settings and Operational Health. Clicked all 21 nav items; each renders without crash. Real pages render correctly for Dashboard, Open Orders, Invoices, Credit Terms, Marketplace, Marketing Assets, Pre-Book Review, Intl Shipments. Placeholder page (data-testid='placeholder-page') renders correctly for the 12 not-yet-wired items (Analytics, Allocations, Aging AR, Customers, Compliance, Onboarding, Forecast Goals, Place Order, ATS Inventory, Commissions, Feedback, Operational Health). All 4 Dashboard Quick Actions (Browse Catalog->Marketplace, Pre-Book Orders->Pre-Book Review, Track Orders->Open Orders, Brand Assets->Marketing Assets) navigate correctly to their target pages. No console/page errors captured.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is 582 lines and contains the full nav + render switch; consider extracting sidebar and route-switch into separate components as it grows.

The dashboard shows a skeleton state briefly on each mount (visible when navigating back to Dashboard); test scripts must wait for quick-action-* selectors before clicking. Not a bug, but a potential perceived-perf issue.
test_credentials: Mock login: empty email+password OR demo@goorin.com / password123
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar structure and nav wiring verified in iteration_15. Use data-testid='login-submit-btn' with empty fields to bypass mock auth. Dashboard page has a skeleton loading state — always wait_for_selector on quick-action-{slug} before clicking. Quick action slugs: marketplace, pre-book-review, open-orders, marketing-assets.
